title: The Lord Surrounds His People

questions.question: Those who trust in the Lord are like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:1 (ESV): "Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion,"

questions.question: Mount Zion which cannot be moved, but abides how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:1 (ESV): "...which cannot be moved, but abides forever."

questions.question: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:2 (ESV): "...so the Lord surrounds his people,"

questions.question: The Lord surrounds his people from this time forth and how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:2 (ESV): "...from this time forth and forevermore."

questions.question: For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:3 (ESV): "For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to the righteous,"

questions.question: Lest the righteous stretch out their hands to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:3 (ESV): "lest the righteous stretch out their hands to do wrong."

questions.question: Do good, O Lord, to those who are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:4 (ESV): "Do good, O Lord, to those who are good,"

questions.question: And to those who are upright in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:4 (ESV): "...and to those who are upright in their hearts!"

questions.question: But those who turn aside to their crooked ways the Lord will lead away with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:5 (ESV): "...the Lord will lead away with evildoers!"

questions.question: What geographic feature is used to describe the Lord's protection?
What shall "righteousness" not rest on?
questions.explanation: Actually, the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the LAND allotted to the righteous.

questions.question: What happens if the scepter of wickedness rests on the righteous land?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:3 (ESV): "lest the righteous stretch out their hands to do wrong."

questions.question: Who are "crooked ways" associated with?
questions.explanation: Psalm 125:5 (ESV): "But those who turn aside to their crooked ways..."

questions.question: Mount Zion is described as what?

key_verse_text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people, from this time forth and forevermore.
